title: 注水式ロードバリア
description: 反射板、ハンドル、注水キャップ、排水プラグ、連結部を備える樹脂製工事バリア。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A molded orange work-zone barrier with wide feet, reflectors, carry handles, fill cap, drain plug and complementary interlocking ends. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.

provenance.rights: Original geometry and material design created for Xenoah Meshcopia under the owner's request for CC-BY-4.0 publication. No third-party meshes, scans, brands, logos or font files.

usages.context: Original city asset created for this library. No external deployment or reuse claimed.
